import_policy: All supplied rows are imported regardless of whether market or source fields are present. Missing values are preserved as missing and are not inferred.
duplicate_policy: Preserve every source row with its source file and row number; do not merge apparent duplicates or conflicts automatically.
verification_limits: The supplied CSV rows do not consistently include per-row primary-source URLs, document identifiers, page or section, or verification date.
Market is absent from most rows or appears only as free text; never infer US/EU or another market.
Power fields do not consistently identify SAE hp versus metric PS, or engine output versus combined-system/peak output.
Rows remain reference candidates and must not populate tax-calculation fields until exact vehicle applicability and primary documentation are reviewed.
